page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with Roman-numbered sections (LXXIV to LXXVIII) set centred between paragraphs. Running head at the top with the page number 87 at the right. Gathering signature F 4 at the bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: & turbant, neq; vel ita suis ipsi decretis acquie-scunt. Ibid.

Tunc cùm insidiis studeant maximoperè se simulant de fide scribere, vt quemadmodū Pilatus manus lauit: ita & ipsi pios religiososque in Christum scribendo interficiant: ac dum de fide definienda negociosos se fingunt, crimen infamiamq; diuersæ alienæq; à recta fide opinionis elabantur. Ibid.

Pauci numero cùm sint, volunt tamen sua præ omnibus valere, & quæ ab ipsis in angulis conflata sunt, ac proinde suspecta, rata esse, summam vim adhibentes, vt dissoluant & irritā faciant totius orbis sedulam & synceram Synodum. Ibid.
Etsi sublimes magnificosq; se faciunt, etsi maiores Pharisæis fimbrias sibi alligant, dilatantq; se verborum sonitu & vim vocisque tenorem probè meditatum habent, nullam ob id fidem meruerint. Ibid.
Occultant animum, ac deinde in scribendo Scripturarum verbis pro esca utuntur, ut latenter in suam malitiam pertrahant ignaros. Ibid.

Ista omnium sectarum ultima, & nunc recēs[?] egressa, dolosa & vafra, cùm videret sorores suas ceteras (inquâ sectas ætate grandiores publicè palamque probrosas haberi, specie suam dissimulat, & litterarum sacrarum verbis, quasi

page.notes: Printed Roman numerals LXXIV to LXXVIII are section numbers and were set as paragraphs. "Ibid." citations are in the text, not in margins. The macron over "recès" is doubtful and marked [?]. "specie" is read from a faint line and may be "speciem". The paragraph ends mid-sentence and continues on the next page.
